recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the original 1..1 verificationStatus cardinality or clinicalStatus invariants for this seed; those differences are governed by later published Patient Care decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-11151 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core AllergyIntolerance and requested replacing mixed AllergyIntolerance.status with clinicalStatus and verificationStatus, both summary/modifier elements, with clinical and verification value sets and invariants related to entered-in-error.
initial_application: Commit ed170ff0754268f2a677a011f9d432d1328415f0 explicitly cited #10642, #11151, and #11920 and replaced AllergyIntolerance status usages in source examples, notes, and the spreadsheet with clinicalStatus and verificationStatus.
additional_context: The same 2016 block vote included FHIR-10642 and FHIR-11920. Later published issues intentionally changed details from the original resolution: FHIR-13997 made verificationStatus 0..1, FHIR-17743 made the status elements CodeableConcept, FHIR-20189 added presumed, and FHIR-25514/FHIR-28458 removed the original clinicalStatus invariants in favor of guidance for negated and refuted records. Zulip evidence matches this timeline and no Confluence conflict was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The active current source defines AllergyIntolerance.clinicalStatus and AllergyIntolerance.verificationStatus as summary modifier elements with required bindings and has no active AllergyIntolerance.status element to fix.
